boundaries: No new DEV6570 or test13078 access
No model parameter update or paid API
feedback: Pair-left official F1 is used only for descriptive within-family utility. Preserve the previously frozen VAR1 PLAN F0 for future learning. No policy update in this family.

intent_protection.candidate_rule: paired one-sided 95% lower bound (CI90 lower endpoint) strictly greater than -1.44 percentage points
intent_protection.source: Frozen VAR-1 PLAN/PLANR aligned utterance bootstrap CI90 half-width; operational repeatability margin, not independently justified task-value tolerance.

interpretation: Terminal whole-system effectiveness is primary. Tool use, evidence novelty and local revision quality are diagnostic only.
Fixed control-then-tools order leaves time effects. Any positive construction result needs matched replication.
Both arms use the same new Reviewer instruction; contrast identifies on-demand tool availability under this complete policy, not the prompt effect against historical PLAN.
Candidate-miss, acquisition failure, review error, routing failure, revision harm and delivery changes are separately described without causal node credit.
No effective result: no default adoption, outcome-dependent threshold change, subgroup admission or larger sampling for rescue.

primary.candidate_rule: paired two-sided CI95 lower bound strictly greater than 0 percentage points

registered_before: Evidence-path model, tokenizer, runtime tool and official scorer contact
required_reports: pooled official SLU F1 and per-row F1 mean separately
empty-gold entity false positives and clean-to-hallucinated transitions
nonempty-gold entity false negatives and false positives
actual supplied example count and empty-example count where trace identifies values
request input volume, model contacts and failure costs
OBS/ORG/SUPPLY/USE attribution, including on-demand SUPPLY and downstream USE
complete role/action/observation/revision/delivery trajectories; all action-not-reached episodes retained
evidence source custody, tool calls and rejected/empty calls, Planner routing and terminal repairs/harms
candidate coverage and candidate-miss ceiling; historical PLAN and PLANR context only
source_handling: After both complete manifests and one official job per full arm seal, bind run_manifest, scores and outputs byte hashes before metric/answer read. Missing or mismatched hashes refuse analysis. No partial scoring, scorer replay or outcome-dependent roster selection.

statistics.equal_scenario: Average scenario pooled scores with equal fixed scenario weights; resample utterance clusters within scenario.
statistics.natural: Resample whole utterances, retaining all dependent recordings together.
statistics.posthoc_subgroups: Descriptive; no admission based on a discovered subgroup.
